subject.title: [Bug]: room_event forces message_tool_only despite visibleReplies=automatic, destabilizing prompt cache

question: Should non-internal room-event turns keep strict message-tool-only delivery while using a session-stable prompt-facing reply contract, or should explicit `groupChat.visibleReplies: automatic` change room-event visible delivery?
rationale: Current code, docs, and tests intentionally keep ambient room events quiet, but the report and linked PR show credible prompt-cache churn and instruction drift that require a product/privacy choice before implementation can be finalized.

options.title: Stabilize Prompt, Keep Strict Delivery
options.body: Keep room-event final text private unless the message tool sends, but make cache-sensitive prompt sections use the session-stable visible-reply contract and put strict per-turn guidance after the cache boundary.

options.title: Honor Automatic For Room Events
options.body: Allow explicit `groupChat.visibleReplies: automatic` to make room-event final text visible, with privacy-focused docs and regression coverage for ambient rooms.

options.title: Document Strict Behavior Only
options.body: Leave runtime behavior as-is and document that `room_event` overrides automatic visible replies, accepting the prompt-cache tradeoff for ambient privacy.

recommendation.title: Stabilize Prompt, Keep Strict Delivery
recommendation.body: Keep room-event final text private unless the message tool sends, but make cache-sensitive prompt sections use the session-stable visible-reply contract and put strict per-turn guidance after the cache boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is closest to the visible-reply and ambient-room policy introduced by the earlier group visible-reply work.
